summary.text: Jeff Peckman is the Unity Party's nominee for governor, on a joint ticket with T.J. Cole. An entrepreneur and longtime campaigner for ballot initiatives and candidates, he describes himself as a "solutionist" and is described as a UFO disclosure activist. He won his party's primary with 146 votes, or 53.7 percent.

paragraphs.text: Peckman was born in Paola, Kansas, on March 1, 1954, and says he spent his first five years on a farm.
He earned a high school diploma from Abraham Lincoln High School and has worked as an entrepreneur.
According to his campaign website, he was the first Vice President of Special Projects for the DaVinci Institute.
Over 28 years Peckman has run three candidate campaigns and three ballot initiative campaigns.
In March 2026 he published a book, RAISE the ZONE.
In his Ballotpedia survey he lists proposals in economic development, health, education, energy, public safety, agriculture and homelessness, as well as disclosure of UFO secrecy.
Peckman defeated Paul Fiorino in the Unity Party primary on June 30, 2026, 146 votes to 126, and appears on the November 3 ballot with T.J. Cole as his running mate.
